These controls are typically used in conjunction with torque converters and speed changers, which are components of the mechanical power transmission equipment. Motor- Transmission Control systems are responsible for managing the power output of the motor and controlling the speed and torque

deliverables_scope: ===== FILE: files/Attachment1_Specifications_1232SA26Q1239.pdf ===== SPECIFICATIONS 1.0 Speciﬁcations Description: Custom 4K Wheat SNP Targeted Amplicon Primer Pool Quantity: 1 Unit Type: Primer Pool (15,000 rxn) Minimum Requirements: The required item is the existing Euroﬁns-developed custom ~4,000-marker wheat SNP targeted amplicon primer pool. The primer pool must be the same custom primer pool previously developed by Euroﬁns BioDiagnostics and used in a small test run. The current procurement is for the same primer pool in a larger quantity.
